name: NZBGet
description: Web-UI update; installer RSA-SHA256 verified vs embedded pubkey.pem (manifest over http).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: NZBGet's source contains an RSA-SHA256 verification utility that hashes an input file, reads a signature record and PEM public key, and calls RSA_verify. Its maintenance update path separately reads an install script from package-info.json; this snapshot does not establish that the web installer path invokes the verifier, uses an embedded key, or obtains its manifest over HTTP.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the web UI's installer/manifest flow, embedded key material, transport URL, and call-site relationship to VerifySignature were not established.

original_evidence.text: | NZBGet | https://github.com/nzbget/nzbget | C++ (daemon + web UI) | Y | N (web-UI initiated only: "Settings → SYSTEM → Check for update"; also exposed as XML-RPC methods `checkupdate`/`startupdate`) | Y (downloads a platform installer/`.run`/`-setup.exe` and executes it with elevated/replace-in-place semantics) | http for the version-manifest fetch (`update-info-link` is `http://nzbget.net/info/nzbget-version-*.json`, not https); download/signature links come from that manifest (scheme as published, unauthenticated at transport layer); actual download performed by NZBGet's own internal `webget` HTTP client | N (the JSON manifest `NZBGET_UPDATE.txt`/version-info file is plain, unsigned, fetched over http) | signature (RSA-SHA256, PKCS#1 v1.5 via OpenSSL `RSA_verify`, over a plaintext hex signature file downloaded alongside the installer) | embedded `pubkey.pem` shipped inside the app directory (repo root `pubkey.pem`, installed to `$NZBOP_APPDIR/pubkey.pem`); no chain of trust beyond "ships with the binary" — corresponding private key not in repo | `pubkey.pem` (repo root); `daemon/main/Maintenance.cpp:32-52,198-206,318-416` (OpenSSL `Signature` class: `ComputeInHash`→SHA-256, `ReadSignature`→hex-decode `.sig.txt`, `ReadPubKey`→`PEM_read_bio_RSA_PUBKEY`, `Verify`→`RSA_verify(NID_sha256,...)`); `daemon/main/nzbget.cpp:872-882` (`ProcessSigVerify`, CLI `-B verify`, exits code 93 on success); `linux/install-update.sh:32-93` (downloads `NZBGET_UPDATE.txt` via http link from `webui/package-info.json`, downloads `.sig.txt` and installer, runs `nzbget -B verify pubkey.pem sig installer`, requires exit code 93, then `sh installer.run --update`); `windows/install-update.bat:70-149,221-227` (same flow; final `"%SETUP_EXE%" /S` silent-installs); `linux/package-info.json:2` and `windows/package-info.json:2` (`"update-info-link": "http://nzbget.net/info/..."`, note plain http). |
